source_quotes: one thing to note we should never skip due to no methodology we should have and should be creating all methodologies necessary
the missing tool is CREATED AUTOMATICALLY on identification of the need via its own zero-shot call site
we publish the findings ... we don't publish offers on the marketplace at all for filling
overlap_check: 40349 Capability Declarations / 40383 MCP Capability Management are about declaring capabilities; none is about creation on need. New.

payload.name: Create What Is Missing On Identified Need
payload.description: When a methodology, tool, MCP or jurisdiction need is identified and nothing covers it, it is created on the spot through its own call site and the finding is published. Even when something is found, the need for a new or changed one is still judged.

principles.name: Closure, not skipping
principles.description: A missing capability is made, not worked around; a step that cannot run is a defect to close.

principles.name: Findings travel, offers do not
principles.description: What was created is published as a finding; gaps are never filled from offers.

heuristics.action: hand it to the marketplace methodology so it is published as a finding, not an offer

heuristics.condition: a plan arrives with many missing capabilities for a small question
heuristics.action: check whether the gaps are real or came from invented provider names in rules

heuristics.condition: a tool is listed by guessing the first few available
heuristics.action: do not list; a tool is either registered or it is a gap

decision_rules.name: Never skip for lack of knowledge
decision_rules.condition: a request needs a methodology and none is found
decision_rules.outcome: create the methodology through its zero-shot call site instead of skipping or answering without one

decision_rules.name: Judge need even when something is found
decision_rules.condition: methodologies or tools were found for the request
decision_rules.outcome: still judge whether a new one or a change to an existing one is needed from the new insight, and act on a yes

decision_rules.name: Create tools on identified need
decision_rules.condition: a tool or MCP the work needs is not registered
decision_rules.outcome: create it automatically through the tool-creation call site as an artifact plus a registry row that is not auto-started; the host spawns nothing

decision_rules.name: Record real gaps
decision_rules.condition: a real action has no registered provider
decision_rules.outcome: list it in missing_capabilities with provenance, and mark the gap when the tool is created

decision_rules.name: Steps are pipeline 9 or provider
decision_rules.condition: a blueprint step is written for a created or missing capability
decision_rules.outcome: use pipeline 9 or a provider step only; a provider is a step type, not a new pipeline
